keyLimits.en: Email ticketing only: routing, analytics, pre-written responses, automations, no omnichannel/chat.
Adds AI agents, knowledge base, omnichannel routing, messaging, live chat, telephony.
Adds Admin Copilot, App Builder, writing tools, quick reports, skills-based routing, IVR.
Intelligent triage, generative AI for voice, approval workflows, sandbox, custom roles.

cautions.en: Listed prices are annual commitment per agent; a small team's real monthly cost multiplies by seat count quickly.
The entry Support Team plan covers email ticketing only, not the omnichannel/chat experience most buyers expect from Zendesk.

capabilities.en: Omnichannel customer support across email, chat, social and phone from one unified inbox.
Built-in AI agents and Admin Copilot for automated triage and agent assistance on higher tiers.
Knowledge base, skills-based routing and IVR available starting from Suite Team/Professional.

limitations.en: No permanent free plan; only a 14-day trial of Suite Professional.
Omnichannel features (chat, messaging, telephony) require moving up to the Suite plans, not available on Support Team.

reason.en: Direct competitor for omnichannel customer support with strong chat and AI bot focus.
Comparable helpdesk platform, more IT-service-management oriented.
Simpler, lower-cost helpdesk alternative for small teams.

unknowns: Monthly (non-annual) per-agent pricing was not shown on the fetched page, only annual commitment prices.
